name: SECOND RAPE
source:
Welcome to "Takatoh Mental Clinic."
The nefarious den of a perverted counselor which preys on violated girls...
ripping open their fresh wounds and rubbing salt on their suffering hearts...!!

Zuiichi Takatoh lurks within... waiting for unsuspecting girls to fall into his trap.
A warped individual, a demon in disguise, he derives pleasure from the pain and suffering of his clients.
They exist to fulfill his deepest darkest desires... and he will make sure they know it.
Using his authority, he violates, humiliates, shames, and entraps the hapless girls.
